title: Cal Cobbs and the Wilberforce scholarship
summary: After two months he returned to Cincinnati to attend Wilberforce on a scholarship arranged by pianist Cal Cobbs, but money problems intervened.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, how long did you stay
Oh, no wonder you don't remember.

Yeah. I wanted to come back to Cincinnati, to a friend of mine who was a wonderful piano player. Carl Call Cobbs his name was. And we were supposed to go to university together. What was that university? He had a music scholarship for me.
Yeah. At this -- because he was a graduate of this university and he had very -- he was very influential. What was -- no. It was in Xenia, Ohio. Wilberforce.
And I was coming back. Cobbs said, 'Come back, Kenny, I've raised this scholarship for you.'
And I went out to the university and I liked it. Sy Oliver was there.
Isn't that where the Lunceford band came out of there?
No, not Wilberforce. They came out of -- what was it? No, not Alabama.
Oh, well, allright. Don't -- but Sy was there.
Yeah. And well, something happened that the -- always the money.
So we began to -- Cal Cobbs and I began to gig in Cincinnati.
Zenia, Ohio, is only about I guess 28 miles from it.
